stem: Which of the following resulted from McCarthyism during the 1950s?

options.label: A
options.text: Membership in the U.S. Communist Party increased.

options.label: B
options.text: U.S. citizens were arrested for being suspected communists.

options.label: C
options.text: Recruitment procedures for the U.S. military branches were reformed.

options.label: D
options.text: U.S. diplomats began to express dissenting political viewpoints more freely.
